name: BT Properties
addr: 800 W El Camino Real Ste 180, Mountain View, CA 94040
hours: Mon-Fri office, emergency line after hours
audience: Apartment residents, building owners and investors on the peninsula
description: Independent residential property manager in Mountain View since 1999, with DRE licence 02034419 and BBB A accreditation, managing apartment holdings across the peninsula.
serviceCopy: Leasing and marketing that keeps vacancy honest.
Maintenance dispatch with published response times.
Owner reporting built on numbers, not adjectives.
insight: DRE licence number and BBB A rating are publishable trust assets they currently hide on a page nobody renders properly.
usps: BBB A rating with a 4,500-resident portfolio
Local ownership, not a national platform
differentiators: Publishes maintenance SLAs, owner reporting samples and a resident portal-first experience

reputation.note: High volume, mediocre average: maintenance responsiveness and communication are the recurring themes. The site should carry the response SLA, not a hero video.

afford: Management companies bill a percentage of rent across thousands of units
Real compliance and licensing records to publish
Reputation repair at this scale is a funded, recurring engagement
risk: 181 public reviews at 3.0 means copy must be operational, never aspirational
Owner approval chains slow launches: ship in phases

art.logo: Set a BT monogram in a stencil grotesque
art.photoNote: Buildings, leasing offices, keys, maintenance log - documentary

copy.h1: Four thousand five hundred residents, and a website from 2015.
copy.sub: Residential property management across the peninsula: leasing, operations and owner reporting, finally explained in public.
copy.lede: BT Properties has managed apartment portfolios here for a quarter century. Their own site still links to Craigslist listings and has not been redrawn since the last administration.
svcCopy: Leasing and marketing that keeps vacancy honest.
Maintenance dispatch with published response times.
Owner reporting built on numbers, not adjectives.

concept.dir: Corporate-but-crafted: a dual-door site for owners and residents, ledger tables, SLA transparency, a portfolio map, and a documentation library. Institutional typography, restrained motion.
interactive: Two-path entry (Owners / Residents) with distinct CTAs
Portfolio table with filters by city and unit count
Document library (sample owner report, lease summary)
concept.refs: A regional asset manager that behaves like a good landlord.

web.note: Audited live: the site still serves media uploaded in 2015, rentals are pushed out to Craigslist links, applications run through a third-party portal, and there is no tenant-facing content on the domain at all. A management company with roughly 4,500 residents and a 2015 web presence.

design.label: Bid & Spec
design.summary: RFP-grade B2B site: sticky section rail, capability statements, compliance/badge matrix, project ledger table, bid-request funnel.
